findings.title: Phase 3 dogfood soak is 15 days old — README still shows 🟡 in progress, blocking Phase 6 decision
findings.detail: Phase 3 'Dogfood / 2-week soak' started 2026-05-21. As of 2026-06-05, 15 days have elapsed — the 2-week soak period ended on 2026-06-04. README still displays '🟡 in progress | started 2026-05-21', which incorrectly signals work in progress rather than complete. plan.md §Phase 3 lists explicit success criteria that should have been evaluated: ≥5 findings closed with Codex gate, ≥1 Codex catch Claude missed, zero phantom-open findings, splittasks MASTER.md surfaced findings correctly in every session. Phase 6 (IFleet fold-in) is explicitly 'gated on Phase 3 soak' — the gate has lifted and no decision has been recorded.
findings.fix_sketch: Update Phase 3 status row to '✅ soak complete | 2026-05-21 → 2026-06-05 (15 days)'. Update Phase 6 row note from 'gated on Phase 3 soak' to 'Phase 3 gate lifted 2026-06-05 — awaiting IFleet fold-in decision'. Add a brief note on which Phase 3 success criteria were or were not met.

findings.title: lane-scheduler-spec.md default model fallback (claude-opus-4-7) is stale — successor model is claude-opus-4-8
findings.detail: lane-scheduler-spec.md §1 Schema rules line 51 states 'Helpers default to claude-opus-4-7 if omitted.' The model claude-opus-4-7 no longer exists — the current model is claude-opus-4-8 (confirmed in IFleet audit this session: config/routing.json and src/classifier/index.ts both updated). The previous finding AUDIT-audit-elevation-a5d1b8c4 (marked fixed in audit/nightly-2026-05-22) included lane-scheduler-spec.md in its file_globs but the fix only added an implementation note to quota-pacing-design.md; the schema default fallback in lane-scheduler-spec.md was not updated. Any agent or script following this spec to provide a default model field would record a non-existent model ID. The schema example values at lines 22 and 37 also still show claude-opus-4-7.
findings.fix_sketch: Update line 51 default: 'Helpers default to claude-opus-4-8 if omitted.' Update schema example values at lines 22 and 37 (lanes[] entry and completed_today entry) from claude-opus-4-7 to claude-opus-4-8.

findings.title: quota-pacing-design.md token bucket table still shows claude-opus-4-7 and claude-haiku-4-5 despite previous fix
findings.detail: quota-pacing-design.md §3.1 Token bucket weight table lists claude-opus-4-7 (weight 3) and claude-haiku-4-5 (weight 0.3) as model ID examples. The previous fix AUDIT-audit-elevation-a5d1b8c4 added an implementation note about prefix matching but did not update the table values themselves. Current canonical model IDs are claude-opus-4-8 and claude-haiku-4-5-20251001. The implementation note at the end of §3.1 also cites 'claude-opus-4-7 vs claude-opus-4' as the motivating example for version-suffix handling — this is now wrong (should be claude-opus-4-8 vs claude-opus-4). Since this is design-only documentation and the implementation note covers the matching case, this is COSMETIC.
findings.fix_sketch: Update the weight table rows: claude-opus-4-7 → claude-opus-4-8, claude-haiku-4-5 → claude-haiku-4-5-20251001. Update the implementation note example from 'claude-opus-4-7 vs claude-opus-4' to 'claude-opus-4-8 vs claude-opus-4'.
